title: Tailwind 4 Theming Generator
description: Generates Tailwind 4 compatible CSS from your Ethlete theme definitions

themesPath.description: Path to your themes file (relative to workspace root)
themesPath.x-prompt: Where is your themes file located?

outputPath.description: Where to output the generated Tailwind themes CSS
outputPath.x-prompt: Where should the generated CSS be saved?

typesOutputPath.description: Where to output the generated `EthleteColorThemeNameRegistry` augmentation (a .d.ts that narrows `etProvideColor` and other theme-name APIs to your actual theme names). Defaults to `outputPath` with its extension swapped to `.d.ts`.

prefix.description: Prefix for Tailwind utility color variable names (e.g., 'et' creates --color-et-primary, usable as bg-et-primary)

runtimePrefix.description: Prefix for the runtime theme-swap mechanism: the CSS custom properties (--<runtimePrefix>-color-primary) and selectors (.<runtimePrefix>-color--<name>) that ProvideColorDirective (etProvideColor) toggles between. Defaults to the same value as 'prefix'. Set this separately when your Tailwind utility prefix needs to differ from your runtime theme-switching prefix (e.g. because '--color-primary' is already a documented public API elsewhere in your app).

defaultTheme.description: Name of the theme to use as the default, overriding any isDefault flags in the theme definitions. Use this when multiple apps share one theme definition set (e.g. in a monorepo) but each app needs a different default.
